cardDescriptor: Creative Afterlife begins with a coffee refill.
panelDescription: Bring back a suitable coffee container you already own. Refill it, mark it, personalise it, and return again—a small test of whether creative attachment can help an existing object stay in use.

copyrightWard.title: Continued Custody
copyrightWard.warning: The object may outlive its first commercial identity. Its repairs, marks, memories, and unofficial future remain with its co-author.
